name: files
description: Filesystem operations inside the workspace: read, write, list, search, copy, move, delete.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file (truncated to max_chars).

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a text file. Parent folders are created automatically.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List files and folders in a directory.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Find files whose names match a glob pattern (e.g. '*.py').

tools.name: grep_text
tools.description: Search file contents for a literal string; returns matching lines with file:line.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copy a file or folder to a new location.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename a file or folder.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Delete a file or folder. Requires force=true to confirm.
